name: Online Geniuses

sources.title: Online Geniuses — 'Largest Slack Community for Marketers'; 53,000+ manually vetted members; free 'Become a member'/'Apply Today' application; marketplace, hiring channel, Q&A sessions, OG Elite paid tier

requirements: A marketing-professional identity — membership is manually vetted ('53,000+ manually vetted members')
Free application via 'Become a member'/sign-up (Slack community)
Channels include hiring, guest-posting, resources — a tool can be shared inside the community but there's no public listing
OG Elite is a paid tier; marketplace/talent network features exist for members
preparation: A genuine marketing background/role for the vetting
Plan to participate — drive-by link drops in a vetted Slack get flagged
workflow: Pass manual vetting into the Slack community
Participate in channels; share resources where relevant (guest-posting, tools channels)
Hiring channel can promote jobs; marketplace surfaces services
watchFor: Not a public directory — nothing here produces an indexable listing; value is community reach
Marketer-only vetting — a founder without a marketing angle may be rejected
Copyright footer says 2022 — some public pages may be stale, though Q&A sessions ran into 2025
countsAsLive: Membership in the Slack community — no public profile or listing is produced
unknowns: Whether vendors can list in the marketplace publicly or only inside Slack
